title: Mac basics
blurb: Finder, iCloud, Launchpad, macOS settings and Mac-only tools.

remedies.title: New to Mac (coming from Windows)
remedies.why: A few differences cover most of the confusion.

steps.text: ⌘ (Command) does what Ctrl does on Windows: ⌘C, ⌘V, ⌘Z.
Right-click = two-finger click on the trackpad, or Control+click.
Settings live in System Settings; Finder = File Explorer; the Dock = taskbar; ⌘Space opens Spotlight search.
Closing a window doesn't quit the app; ⌘Q quits it.

remedies.title: Delete files or text forward on a Mac
remedies.why: The Mac's delete key deletes backwards; Fn+Delete deletes forwards.

steps.text: Fn+Delete deletes the character to the right.
⌘+Delete moves a selected file to the Bin; ⌘+Option+Delete deletes immediately.

remedies.title: iCloud storage is full
remedies.why: Photos, iPhone backups and iCloud Drive share the same storage.

steps.text: System Settings › your name › iCloud › Manage shows what uses it.
Delete old iPhone/iPad backups and large files from iCloud Drive.
Upgrade storage, or move old photos to an external drive.

remedies.title: Close apps properly or see what's still running
remedies.why: Mac apps keep running after you close their window.

steps.text: Press ⌘Q to quit the active app; a dot under its Dock icon means it's still running.
⌘+Option+Esc to force quit a stuck app.

remedies.title: Run Disk Utility First Aid
remedies.why: First Aid checks and repairs the disk's file system.

steps.text: Open Disk Utility, select the Macintosh HD volume, click First Aid › Run.
For the startup disk, Recovery mode can repair more.

remedies.title: Reset NVRAM / SMC (and what to do on Apple silicon)
remedies.why: Intel Macs had resets for power and startup settings; Apple silicon Macs do it on a full shutdown.

steps.text: Apple silicon: shut down, wait 30 seconds, start again. That's the equivalent.
Intel NVRAM: start while holding Option+⌘+P+R for ~20 seconds.
Intel SMC: follow Apple's steps for your model (they differ with the T2 chip).

remedies.title: An app is missing from Launchpad or the Dock
remedies.why: The app may be running from Downloads or a disk image, not installed in Applications.

steps.text: Search for it with ⌘Space.
Apps opened from a .dmg must be dragged into Applications, then the .dmg ejected.
Open Finder › Applications and drag it into the Dock.

remedies.title: Mac keeps returning to the login screen
remedies.why: A login item or damaged preference crashes the session.

steps.text: Start in Safe Mode and log in; if it works, remove recent login items.
Check free disk space; a full disk causes login loops.
From Recovery, run Disk Utility First Aid.

remedies.title: Desktop and Documents moved into iCloud Drive
remedies.why: "Desktop & Documents Folders" in iCloud stores them online and can download them on demand.

steps.text: System Settings › your name › iCloud › iCloud Drive › Desktop & Documents Folders.
Turning it off leaves the files in iCloud Drive; copy them back to your Mac folders first.

remedies.title: A guide says to run a command in Terminal
remedies.why: Terminal commands can change anything on the Mac; sudo runs them as administrator.

steps.text: Only run commands from sources you trust and understand.
sudo asks for your password; nothing appears while you type it, that's normal.

remedies.escalate: On work Macs, ask IT before running admin commands.
